svg.title: FIG-05 Generated Platform explicit cold lifecycle One external privileged task owner advances serially
svg.desc: Cold object: no successful running permission; Check context / started Reject ISR and masks; physical implementation checks privilege; SoC start_system / start_resources Exact cold clock, timebase, pin-lease prerequisites; Initialize instances in declaration order Count potentially effectful attempts before calling for cleanup; start primary=SUCCESS External application may operate; no scheduler start; Externally close producers / direct writers first Executor continues draining; join callers and observers; nx_platform_stop: stop initialized instances in reverse order Decrease initialized count only after each successful step; Provider stop_system Restore owned pin / gate / timebase / cache effects; stop=SUCCESS: remaining effects released Does not promise continued active product-safe output drive; Initialization error: retain primary Call nx_platform_stop to collect cleanup outcome; BUSY / IO: retain uncleaned leases and storage May be partially stopped; continue required service, then retry; Explicit start; Rejected: preserve existing lifecycle and effects No newly authorized operational calls; Context / STATE error; Prerequisites passed; Stage succeeded; Failure after acquiring effects; All succeeded; Any failure; Reverse cleanup including the effectful failed instance; Product decides to stop; Stop-call prerequisites satisfied; All instances released; First uncleaned effect encountered; Observe successful cleanup; System cleanup failed; Retry the actual retained stage No forced timeout reclamation; New epoch / new lifecycle
